semantic_fidelity.reason: All eight named components and eight directed topologies are visible, but three labels remain ambiguously owned exactly as observed blind: task+ctrl RPC, task dispatch, and starts/manages. In particular task dispatch is directly under the daemon-bound run, not uniquely attached to the engine link. The worker labels lose gRPC specificity by saying only RPC, and HTTP over UDS loses the source-required filesystem purpose of the daemon seam. Correct JSON ownership and prose expansions outside the view do not repair the visible meanings.

arrow_traceability.reason: All eight independent source stems reach unique intact target arrowheads with correct directions. Both worker/runtime arrows exist separately. Zero crossings, no shared runs or drawn junctions, no extra apparent relation, and no requested bus. The adjacent engine/daemon bends at [21,21]/[22,21] point away from each other rather than making a fake branch. This topology-only pass does not waive semantic label failures.

layout_fit.reason: The captured normal and selected grids measure 77x47, the header says 77x47 @100%, and the saved transcript says viewport: 77x47 zoom: 1.00 natural. All graph content is visible at [17,7,45,36], with no clipping or legend overlap and zero crossings. Source leaves within-band order free, so no source-order violation is observed. However the required separate actual live-pane measurement is missing: manifest pane_cols and pane_rect are null. Grid dimensions/app viewport are not an independently measured pane rectangle; live_pane is therefore null.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Source-backed conceptual families are near and hue-related: runtime/engine teal, backend/container green, filesystem/Blobnet blue; worker gold and daemon pink distinguish separate process/interface concepts. There is no geometric-depth color grouping or source-tier reordering. Related paired nodes occupy nearby bands, while compute and storage lanes stay separately traceable.

border_integrity.reason: All eight nodes have four complete sides and four rounded corners, each normal perimeter with one continuous RGB foreground. Select-all covers all 8/8 node occurrences and all 276/276 perimeter cells with RGB(216,166,87) plus bold. Worker foreground already uses that gold normally, but its full-border bold change proves selection. Simultaneous coverage does not claim individual interactive selection tests or drag-handle behavior not captured.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen skill, binary, corrected rubric, dataset, case inputs, final spec, attempts and capture hashes verified. Generator viz-ds03-7/DeepSeek and independent reviewer viz-judge03-runtime/Sol are distinct; blind hash is unchanged and predates reveal. Combined check stdout+stderr (verified from the capture helper whose hash matches the frozen metadata), manifest exit=0/time window, exact helper command, normal/selected ANSI, static frames, and recorded pane close exist. Required separate actual pane width/rectangle is absent. Extra check probes are disclosed, not grounds for an invented process-budget failure. Clerical stale reviewer identity was corrected by captain before result creation; no identity was falsified.

The view does not uniquely bind that action to backend lifecycle rather than the neighboring storage route. This repeats the blind task-dispatch ownership defect.

task+ctrl RPC at [23,12,13,1] lies between opposing worker/runtime routes: its start is right of the down-route at column 21, but its last character directly abuts the return-route at column 36. Separate topology is clear, yet the required task/control label owner remains crowded/uncertain, as saved blind.

Seam specificity is lost: task+ctrl RPC and events+mgmt RPC say only RPC, not the worker gRPC named in the fixed constraint; HTTP over UDS preserves transport distinction but omits the filesystem purpose required by the runtime -> daemon relation. Abbreviations ctrl/mgmt/vol and task dispatch are otherwise meaningful. This finding is about missing source meaning, not a requirement to repeat every original word verbatim. Generator prose expands the meanings outside the visible artifact and cannot supply an on-view key.
